name: usv-operator-station
description: USV operator station frontend (vanilla ES modules) + FastAPI backend. type:module lets Node run the ES-module unit tests and --check the browser modules.
//check:shell: Runtime shell-geometry assertions against a RUNNING backend (default http://127.0.0.1:8210): every shell region owns its own grid cell and the map never covers the ribbon/rail/dock/inspector. Viewport-overflow tests cannot catch a full-screen map, so this checks relative rectangles instead. Needs Playwright, which is deliberately not a dependency of the station: npm install --no-save playwright && npx playwright install chromium.
